sections.Profile:
Stop 'N' Go , produced by Williams Electronic Games Inc. in August 1964, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Norm Clark with artwork by Art Stenholm. The game features a transportation theme, incorporating automobile travel elements.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1964
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Public Services, Transportation, Cities, Original Theme, Cars
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Norm Clark
- Art: Art Stenholm
